title: RF Exercise Knowledge Object (v2.1 — governance + user-facing plan-card metadata, backward-compatible)
$comment: NON-EXECUTABLE structural schema for future Rectus Femoris exercise-knowledge objects. It documents SHAPE, STATUS DISCIPLINE, and DOSAGE/CLEARANCE PROHIBITIONS only. Exercise objects are inert metadata: they hold tissue/function/position/demand tags, contraindications, safety blockers, monitoring triggers, regressions, progressions, substitutions, and RF rule links. They MUST NOT carry active dosage, sets/reps/frequency/rest/intensity/duration, return dates, progression increments as prescription, diagnosis authority, rehab-plan authority, or return-to-training / return-to-sport clearance. Authoring a conformant object grants it NO clinical authority. During this phase approval_status MUST NOT be 'approved'. The companion validator scripts/validate-exercise-knowledge.mjs enforces the dosage/clearance prohibitions programmatically (deep key + value scan) because they exceed plain draft-07 expressiveness. Unknown top-level fields are DISALLOWED (additionalProperties:false) — the safer of the two options the spec allows — so new metadata categories require a reviewed schema change.

exercise_id.description: Stable unique identifier for an RF exercise object, e.g. RF-EX-001. Empty string permitted only in the blank template.

module.description: Owning clinical module. Only rectus_femoris is supported in v1.0.

approval_status.description: Clinical approval lifecycle. 'approved' is intentionally NOT permitted in this phase.

executable.description: MUST be false. No exercise object is executable.

permitted_use.description: The only role an exercise object may play: inert metadata. Never dosage or clearance authority.

contraction_bias.description: Contraction-type bias tags, e.g. isometric, isotonic, eccentric, lengthened.

position_tags.description: Joint-position / muscle-length-bias tags, e.g. hip_flexed, hip_neutral, knee_extended, long_length.

speed_power_demand.description: Qualitative tag (e.g. low|moderate|high|unspecified). NOT a numeric target.

stretch_demand.description: Qualitative tag. NOT a numeric target.

impact_demand.description: Qualitative tag. NOT a numeric target.

field_demand_tags.description: Running / sprinting / kicking / change-of-direction exposure tags.

safety_blockers.description: Conditions under which this exercise must not be offered; align with RF-SAF rule families. Metadata only — does not itself execute a block.

allowed_when.description: Qualitative suitability/irritability tags (metadata), not a clearance decision.

blocked_when.description: Qualitative unsuitability tags (metadata), not a clearance decision.

progression_options.description: IDs/labels of harder exercise options. A reference list, NOT an authorization to progress.

regression_options.description: IDs/labels of easier exercise options. A reference list only.

substitution_options.description: IDs/labels of equivalent exercise options. A reference list only.

dosage_status.description: Declares that no active dosage is carried here. Never a value that asserts a prescription.

dosage.description: Inert dosage PLACEHOLDER. Uses validator-safe neutral keys ONLY. The conventional prescriptive keys (sets, reps, frequency, rest, intensity, duration, progression_increment, return_date) are intentionally NOT used here because the governance discipline scans key NAMES and treats those names as contraband even when null. Every value below must remain null; active_prescription_present must remain false.

prescribed_volume.description: Placeholder for sets/reps style volume — must stay null.

prescribed_load.description: Placeholder for intensity/load — must stay null.

prescribed_schedule.description: Placeholder for frequency — must stay null.

prescribed_recovery_interval.description: Placeholder for rest — must stay null.

prescribed_session_length.description: Placeholder for duration — must stay null.

prescribed_progression_step.description: Placeholder for progression increment — must stay null.

prescribed_target_timeline.description: Placeholder for any return/RTS date — must stay null.

source_refs.description: Citations/source labels. Carry no dosage or clearance authority.

evidence_claim_ids.description: QRF evidence-claim IDs. Reference only; never create dosage or clearance authority.

linked_rule_ids.description: RF v1.2 rule IDs this exercise relates to. A linkage, NOT an inheritance of any rule's authority.

canonical_name.description: v2 governance metadata (OPTIONAL — not in required, preserving the existing 87 objects). An object including ANY v2 governance field is a v2-governed object; the validator then enforces guardrail_notes + source-metadata completeness and high-caution/exclude rules. Legacy objects omitting all of them validate unchanged. Inert classification metadata only — no dosage/prescription/progression/readiness/RTT-RTS/clearance authority. This field: stable snake_case canonical exercise name from the decision table.

final_decision.description: Decision-table classification. Classification metadata only — not a clearance or readiness decision.

evidence_grade.description: Strict evidence grade per the decision table (no Grade A survives the merge, but A is allowed structurally).

central_tendon_fibrosis_risk.description: Central-tendon / fibrosis re-injury risk tier for this RF profile.

manual_review_required.description: Whether clinician manual review is required before authoring/approval. null only in the blank template.

injury_site_relevance.description: Which RF tissue site(s) this exercise is relevant to, so the central-tendon/fibrosis case can filter the library.

guardrail_notes.description: Mandatory negated-governance block for v2-governed objects: 'not a prescription', 'not dosage', 'not progression', 'not readiness', 'not RTT/RTS', 'not clearance', 'not a test'. Enforced by the validator when any v2 governance field is present.

source_ids.description: Decision-table source ids (e.g. SG-S4, CR-S18, CGDR-S2). Reference only.

user_facing_name.description: v2.1 user-facing plan-card metadata (OPTIONAL — not in required; existing 87 objects unaffected). DISPLAY metadata only: does NOT create dosage, progression, readiness, RTT/RTS, clearance, or prescription authority, and never exposes internal governance/evidence/risk. This field: friendly display name shown on the rehab-plan card.

user_facing_summary.description: Display only. One-line plain-language 'what it is'.

user_facing_purpose.description: Display only. Plain-language 'why this is in your plan'. Never labels an exercise 'supportive'; no clinical/governance language.

user_facing_instructions.description: Display only. Plain-language steps (string or array of strings). No dosage/sets/reps/dates/percentages.

user_facing_safety_note.description: Display only. Comfort/stop guidance. NOT a readiness/clearance/return statement.

plan_card_category.description: Display grouping for the plan card; derived from internal classification. Not a clinical decision.

plan_card_subcategory.description: Display only. Optional finer user-friendly label.

difficulty_label.description: Display only. Relative complexity. MUST NOT imply readiness, clearance, or approval.

advanced_label.description: Display only. Optional softer external framing for internally high-caution/clinician-review items. Never exposes internal high-caution.

easier_option_labels.description: Display only. Plain names of gentler alternatives. NOT progression authority or sequencing.

harder_option_labels.description: Display only. Plain names of more demanding alternatives. NOT progression authority or sequencing.

related_exercise_labels.description: Display only. Plain 'see also' names. No sequencing.

media.description: Inert media placeholders for FUTURE support. No fetching, no binary, no Supabase, no UI. Asset/url fields are references only.

user_facing_status.description: Copy lifecycle for the user-facing text. NOT clinical approval.

log_completion_available.description: Future plan/logging capability flag (display intent only). Stores no user data and asserts no progression/readiness.
